rationale: Paardekooper2010 develops a torque prescription based on linear (Lindblad and corotation) torque formulae, not a deterministic perturbative correction framework; changing 'stochastic forcing term' to 'deterministic perturbative correction' mis-categorises the method type so that ref.py reading the cited paper returns CONTRADICTED.
ground_truth_description: The description of the turbulence treatment method was changed from a 'stochastic forcing term' (correct) to a 'deterministic perturbative correction' (incorrect method category), while the cite key Paardekooper2010 remains unchanged.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: We will work under simple general assumptions that treat the effect of turbulence as a stochastic forcing term superimposed on the classic linear Lindblad torque \citep{Paardekooper2010}.
